name: bagprotocol
description: On-chain strategy baskets for tokenized stocks: one-click buy and sell, every fee verifiable on-chain.
longDescription:
BAG Protocol lets anyone build and follow on-chain strategy baskets ("Bags") of tokenized stocks and crypto on Robinhood Chain.

- One-click buy: a whole basket is bought in a single transaction through LI.FI Composer. With MetaMask's smart account, approvals and purchase need one confirmation.
- One-click sell: exit every position back to USDG in one transaction.
- Non-custodial: tokens stay in your own wallet. BAG never holds user funds.
- Creators publish strategies; versions can be registered on-chain and any Bag can be forked.
- Fair fees: creators earn a performance fee only on profit, paid on-chain in the same transaction as the sale.
- Transparent: the public Proof page shows verified TVL, execution success rate and fees paid, each figure linked to its on-chain transaction.

Live at https://bagprotocol.com
